int_name: N FRONT ST & E WYOMING AVE

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, despite being controlled by traffic lights. The roadway surface is significantly degraded, and the wide, unmarked lanes create an unpredictable environment for those crossing on foot.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The road surface is heavily worn and uneven, which can cause tripping hazards for pedestrians and unpredictable vehicle movements.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While traffic lights are present for vehicles, there are no visible walk/don't-walk signals to guide pedestrian movement.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a two-lane urban street with mixed residential and commercial land use. While sidewalks are present on both sides, there is a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks, signals, or curb ramps at the visible intersection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated path.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and traffic signals, though it lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads. The environment is characterized by faded crosswalk markings and fair-to-poor pavement conditions that may affect accessibility.
